# ux

`sounds.cpp` implements `sounds::component` for streamed music override resolution and Miles Sound System stream-hook integration.

## Contents

- [sounds.cpp](./sounds.cpp) — Defines `sounds::component`, override resolution helpers, stream-opening stubs, and loop-block suppression.

## API Surface

`sounds::component::post_load()` detours `_AIL_set_stream_loop_block@12` and redirects `music_stream_callsite_1`, `music_stream_callsite_2`, `music_stream_callsite_3`, `ail_open_stream_callsite_1`, and `ail_open_stream_callsite_2`.

`sounds::component::pre_destroy()` clears `ail_set_stream_loop_block_hook`; `REGISTER_COMPONENT(sounds::component)` remains commented out.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`find_music_override()` reads alias data through `try_get_alias_name()` or streamed metadata through `try_get_file_info()`, builds candidates with `add_candidate()`, and accepts the first path returned by `filesystem::find_file`.

`open_music_stream_stub()` stores `current_override_path`, optionally invokes `show_override_notice()`, calls `streamed_sound_open_function`, and clears thread-local state through `gsl::finally`.

`ail_open_stream_stub()` resolves `_AIL_open_stream@12` from `mss32.dll`, substitutes `current_override_path`, and returns `0` when the export is unavailable.

`ail_set_stream_loop_block_stub()` suppresses loop updates for overridden streams and forwards ordinary streams through `ail_set_stream_loop_block_hook`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`sanitize_name()` replaces `\ / : * ? " < > |` with `_`.

Alias lookup uses `sounds/music/{}.mp3` and `sounds/music/{}.wav`.

File metadata lookup uses `sounds/music/{}`, `sounds/music/{}.mp3`, and `sounds/music/{}.wav`.

`try_get_alias_name()` reads `(*request)[0]`; `try_get_file_info()` reads `(*request)[4]`.

`streamed_sound_file_view` stores `directory` and `name`; guarded readers use `__try/__except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER)`.

`add_candidate()` rejects empty and duplicate paths.

`show_override_notice()` is compiled only under `DEBUG` and emits `sounds: overriding %s with %s\n`.

`current_override_path` is `thread_local`; `override_notice_mutex` and `last_notified_override` deduplicate notices across threads.
